text.description: Explore a peaceful krill migration in an interactive SVG ocean. Drag, zoom and follow the swarm through a gently animated 2.5D seascape.
text.depth_label: Illustrative scene layers, not actual water depth
text.focus_label: Focus on and follow a krill
text.scene_title: The quiet migration — an ocean in motion
text.scene_description: Coral-pink krill drift through layers of blue-green water. Drag to pan, scroll or pinch to zoom, and select a krill to follow. Press F to focus, 0 to reset, and Space to pause.
text.intro_lead: Even the smallest lives have a world to explore.
text.intro_line_two: Follow a swarm of krill on an endless journey.
text.view_line_two: See the wonder in the small.
text.noscript: Enable JavaScript to watch the krill animation and use drag, zoom and follow controls. You can still read this page and change its language.
text.about_copy: Krillhub is an animated illustration you can explore. Light, currents and krill are drawn in SVG layers. Distant layers drift slowly while nearby layers glide past, creating 2.5D depth through flat parallax.
text.art_note: This is an artistic interpretation of krill migration, not a scientific simulation of animal behaviour, water depth or a real ocean location.
text.privacy: No sign-in. No tracking. Just let your eyes follow the tide.

messages.lost-krill: This little light has drifted away. Press F to find your next companion.
messages.fullscreen-unavailable: Fullscreen is unavailable in this browser. Try immersive mode instead.
